title: 235 libraries plus 16 mobiles currently under threat
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: On the (semi) positive side, the Wandsworth figure has changed – 1 library faced with closure (instead of previously reported 6), others will have reduced hours. On the debit side, Wigan announce some libraries will close, Stoke withdraw RNIB talking book service and the British Library loses 200 jobs.
